1. Joint position paper on the EU?s policy and regulatory approach to cocoa Partnership agreements, June 2021 2. Voice and companies Joint position paper on the EU?s policy and regulatory approach to cocoa: human rights and environmental due diligence

4. Developed and submitted feedback to the open consultation to the EU Commission for the drafting of a Proposal for an Initiative on Sustainable Corporate Governance.
5. - Joint CSO letter to Kaag/Müller applauding their living income declaration: Response to joint declaration regarding Living Wage and Living Income together with Fair Wear Foundation, Fairtrade Nederland, FNV, CNV, IDH, Rainforest Alliance, FairFood, Save The Children
6. Build Back Better letter sent to members of Dutch parliament
7. Recommendations to the SER committee that develops advice for Dutch government on DD; input for Adviesaanvraag Gepaste Zorgvuldigheidsverplichting IMVO
8. Solidaridad provided feedback to Lafarge Human Rights and Social Value Policy updated policy. Comments were integrated in the final document.
9. Feedback submitted for the consultation of the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises ( pros and cons and the way forward) 10. Recommendations on Including smallholders in EU action to protect and restore the world?s forests Briefing paper shared with relevant policy and decision makers (European Commission & Parliament /Netherlands and Germany)
11. Suggestions for inclusive national due diligence legislation submitted to Dutch Parliamentarians , through MVO platform / IDVO 12. CGF Guidance on Forest Positive Suppliers for Beef presented (Sol organized webinar with ADP to feed it) + comments from SOL 13. Joint statement with FTAO, RA, etc. Legislating for Impact with recommendations to make human rights and environmental due diligence work for smallholders (focus on Living income, purchasing practices and long trade relationships) 14. Solidaridad REC Europe preliminary position on EU Deforestation proposal sent to EC, national government representatives and other stakeholders 15. Signed on to Open Data Principles in Corporate Sustainability Reporting to be included in upcoming HREDD Legislation 16. With FWF and ETI we published a Joint position on an EU Regulatory Framework including Mandatory Human Rights and Environmental Due Diligence
17. Joint statement of Fair Wear Foundation, Ethical Trading Initiative and Solidaridad Germany on the German Draft Due Diligence Law, in May 2021.

1. [EU lobby] concrete amendments for the deforestation-regulation proposal shared with several policy- makers (Christophe Hansen, Gerrit Krause, Assistant of MEP Delara B, member states ( netherlands, Belgium) etc. Coalition on smallholder farmers for the deforestation regulation (FTA, RFA, IUCN, FERN, Tropenbos, SOL) worked on amendments for the deforestation- regulation proposal and advocated for their inclusion in the parliament. 2. [EU lobby] general recommendations based on the detailed amendments shared will 400 MEPs and contacts in member states. 3. [EU lobby] Gave input to the online stakeholder consultation from the Dutch government for the revision of the National Action Plan Business and Human Rights 4. [EU lobby] Recommendation on the CSDD (10 things) shared with MEPs, member states, CSOs and other. Includes advice on how to incorporate Gender-responsive due diligence. 5. [EU lobby] New Amendments on the deforestation regulation based on Hansen’s report shared and discussed with his advisor and other MEPs. Coalition on smallholder farmers for the deforestation regulation (FTA, RFA, IUCN, FERN, Tropenbos, SOL) worked on new amendments based on the report from the Rapporteur from the EP 6. [EU lobby] Letter shared with EC and others to ask (petition) for an ex-ante evaluation of the regulation on smallholder farmers. [EU lobby] Letter to European Commission, co-signed by 50 CSOs from north and south, drafted by EC letter on smallholder assessment , drafted by FTA, RFA, IUCN, FERN, Tropenbos and SOL 7. [EU lobby] Provided input to the BHOS consultation 8. [EU lobby] Cocoa Coalition recommendations for the CSDDD 9. [EU lobby] Letter to Czech Council Presidency expressing concerns on their position on the CSDDD 10. [EU lobby] Joint statement calling for agricultural sector standards as part of the CSRD 11. [EU lobby] Meetings with MEPs Schneider and (assistants of) Hautala to discuss amendments on CSDDD to make the legislation more beneficial to to smallholders (e.g. inclusion of the right to a living income, meaningful stakeholder engagement, provisions for responsible disengagement only as a last resort and promotion of better purchasing practices as part of the due diligence process) 12. [Cross commodity] Provided written feedback to the 1st draft of the handbook on living wage and living income as part of the OECD expert group 13. [EU lobby] Met with with assistants of MEPs to share recommendations for a more inclusive and stronger CSDDD, including staff of MEPs Marc Tarabella, Lara Wolters, and Axel Voss 14. [EU lobby] Met with staff of the Permanent Representation of Estonia and Greece to share recommendations about the CSDDD 15. [EU lobby] Responded to US Government consultation on Deforestation measures together with REC NAM, 16. [General] provided feedback to the 2nd draft of the OECD handbook living wage and income 17. [EU lobby] Engaged with the staff of MEP Heidi Hautala to prepare an event to share our recommendations on the CSDDD with other EU policy makers. The event itself will be in 2023 but recommendations were shared with MEP Hautala and her staff in the preparation stage. 18. [EU lobby] Shared recommendations and fostered discussion with regional and national level of government in Peru, embassies and sector representatives about the impact of the upcoming EU deforestation regulation 19. [EU Lobby]. Joint statement with 53 NGOs from north and south to ask for Partnerships and supporting measures accompanying the EU Deforestation regulation
